description: Notes search: notes like a Yap user's, and questions as they'd ask Chat, each answered by one note. Some share the note's words, most say it differently. Used by `yap.exe eval --bench embed` (src-tauri/src/ai/eval/serving.rs) to compare an embedding model with Chat's keyword search.

notes.title: Dentist
notes.content: Appointment with Dr Patel at Riverside Dental on Thursday 6 November at 9:40. Check-up and a scale and polish. Bring the NHS exemption form. Reschedule fee is £20 if cancelled with less than 24 hours' notice.

notes.title: Launch plan
notes.content: The beta ships on Friday 14 November if the installer bug is fixed by Wednesday. Dave owns the installer fix; Priya checks the signing certificate. Marketing wants screenshots by Monday. Hold the Mac build until December.

notes.title: Kitchen renovation
notes.content: Harlow Kitchens quoted £14,200 including fitting, quartz worktops, eight weeks lead time. The joiner quoted £11,800 with laminate and no appliance fitting. Electrician needs two days to move the sockets for the island.

notes.title: Running plan
notes.content: Week 6 of the half-marathon plan: Tuesday 8 km easy, Thursday intervals 6 x 800 m, Saturday 16 km long run. Left knee tight after last week's long run; foam roll. Race on 7 December in Cardiff, target under 1:55.

notes.title: Book club
notes.content: Next book: The Remains of the Day. Meeting at Sarah's on the 28th at 7:30. Sarah is vegetarian, bring snacks. Return the overdue library copy of Klara and the Sun.

notes.title: Car service
notes.content: The Golf is due its 60,000-mile service: £340 plus £95 for front brake pads. MOT expires 3 January. Rear left tyre loses pressure in the cold. Insurance renews 19 November, last year £612.

notes.title: Garden jobs
notes.content: Plant 60 tulip bulbs along the front path in November. Move the hydrangea to the shady corner in spring. The water butt tap leaks; replace it. Prune the apple tree in February.

notes.title: Easter holiday
notes.content: Options: Lisbon (flights £180 each, four nights), a cottage near Keswick in the Lake District (£620 for the week), or Copenhagen. The kids want a beach. One passport runs out in June. Budget about £2,000.

notes.title: Team retro
notes.content: Went well: release checklist, fewer late deploys, faster code review. Didn't: flaky end-to-end tests on CI, nobody owns the support inbox, too many Tuesday meetings. Priya to quarantine flaky tests, Dave to draft a support rota.

notes.title: Mum's birthday
notes.content: Mum turns 70 on 12 December. Booked a table for eight at The Olive Tree for Saturday the 13th, 7pm. Ideas for a present: a framed print of the old house, or the cookery course she mentioned. Ask Aunt Jean to bring the photo albums.

notes.title: Boiler
notes.content: The boiler pressure keeps dropping to 0.5 bar. Engineer from HeatWise is coming on Monday between 8 and 12. Annual service was last done in March. The warranty runs until 2027 if the service is kept up.

notes.title: Podcast ideas
notes.content: Episode ideas: how speech recognition got good enough to run on a laptop; interview a nurse about night shifts; the history of the shipping container; why British trains are expensive. Ask Mo whether his studio is free on Sundays.

notes.title: Wi-Fi setup
notes.content: The mesh router admin page is 192.168.68.1. Guest network is Yap-Guest. The upstairs node drops out when the microwave is on; moved it off the shelf. ISP support number is on the back of the hub. Contract ends in April.

notes.title: Recipe: dal
notes.content: Red lentil dal: rinse 250 g lentils, simmer with turmeric and a litre of water for 20 minutes. Fry cumin seeds, garlic, ginger and chilli in ghee, tip into the lentils. Finish with lemon juice and coriander. Serves four.

notes.title: Interview: support engineer
notes.content: Candidate Elena: five years at a SaaS helpdesk, strong on Zendesk and SQL, calm under pressure in the role play. Weaker on scripting. Salary expectation £38k. Team's vote: hire, start date mid-January after her notice period.

notes.title: Tax return
notes.content: Self-assessment due 31 January. Need the P60, the rental income statement from the letting agent, and receipts for the home office equipment. Last year's payment on account was £1,240. Accountant is Hughes & Co.

notes.title: Bike repair
notes.content: The rear derailleur skips in the two smallest cogs. Probably a stretched chain; the chain checker said 0.75. Order a new chain and cassette. Bike shop on Mill Lane charges £45 for a service.

notes.title: Quarterly planning
notes.content: Q1 priorities: meeting notes for Teams calls, a faster first-run download, and Windows on ARM builds. Budget for contractors cut by 10 percent. Hiring freeze until March except for the support role. Review progress on 15 February.

notes.title: Vet
notes.content: Biscuit's booster vaccinations are due on 2 December. She's been scratching her left ear; ask about mites. Flea treatment every month, next one on the 20th. The pet insurance excess is £99.

notes.title: Moving house checklist
notes.content: Book the removal van for 24 January. Tell the council and the electoral roll. Redirect post with Royal Mail for six months. Take meter readings on the day. Cancel the window cleaner and the milk delivery.

notes.title: Guitar practice
notes.content: Practising the F barre chord, still buzzing on the B string. Learn the intro to Wonderwall, then Blackbird by the end of the month. Twenty minutes a day with the metronome at 70 bpm. New strings are 10-46 gauge.

notes.title: Neighbour fence
notes.content: The fence between us and number 14 blew down in the storm. Their side is responsible according to the deeds (the T marks are on their side). They suggested splitting the cost: about £450 each for featheredge panels.

notes.title: Customer call: Northwind
notes.content: Northwind wants single sign-on with Azure AD and an export of all meeting transcripts each month. They're on 120 seats. Renewal is in March; they hinted at moving to a competitor if SSO isn't there by then.

notes.title: Photography course
notes.content: Evening course at the community college, Wednesdays from 15 January for ten weeks, £180. Covers manual mode, composition and editing in Lightroom. Bring the camera and a 50 mm lens. Field trip to the docks in week six.
